# Modern Spring Boot Microservices Best Practices Plugin ### Distributed Microservices Architecture, Resilience4j & Observability [![Antigravity Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Plugin%20v1.0.0-4F46E5.svg)](https://antigravity.google) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-10B981.svg)](./LICENSE) [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/Website-halcyontech.com.br-008080.svg)](https://www.halcyontech.com.br/) [![Organization](https://img.shields.io/badge/Organization-HalcyonTech--LTDA-black.svg)](https://github.com/HalcyonTech-LTDA)

Comprehensive engineering standards, architectural patterns, and production guardrails for modern Microservices using modern Spring Boot 3.x+: database-per-service isolation, declarative HTTP interfaces with RestClient, Resilience4j fault tolerance, transactional Outbox & Saga distributed data patterns, Spring Cloud Gateway with OAuth2/JWT token relay, distributed tracing with Micrometer & OpenTelemetry, and consumer-driven contract testing.

--- ## Installation & Verification ### Antigravity CLI (`agy`) Install directly into your Antigravity environment via the CLI: ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/HalcyonTech-LTDA/modern-spring-boot-microservices-best-practices ``` Verify that the plugin is active and adheres to the strict official schema: ```bash agy plugin list agy plugin validate --strict ./modern-spring-boot-microservices-best-practices ``` --- ## Overview Transitioning from a monolithic architecture to distributed microservices promises developer autonomy, granular scalability, and rapid deployment velocity. However, without rigorous architectural discipline and cloud-native standards, microservice ecosystems rapidly degrade into critical production failure modes: - **The Distributed Monolith**: Overly fragmented "nano-services" coupled by shared databases, synchronous RPC chains, and co-dependent deployments. - **The Dual-Write Data Corruption Trap**: Updating a local database and publishing a Kafka/RabbitMQ message in a single method, leading to irrecoverable data loss and split-brain states when network blips occur. - **Cascading Outages**: Synchronous inter-service calls without circuit breakers, timeouts, or jittered retries, causing a slow downstream dependency to exhaust all worker threads across the entire mesh. - **Perimeter Vulnerabilities & Security Drift**: Leaking internal service endpoints to the public internet, duplicating authentication logic, or using stateful sessions in downstream microservices. - **Observability Blind Spots**: Disconnected logs and traces without W3C TraceContext propagation, making it impossible to diagnose cross-service latency regressions or distributed transaction failures. - **Flaky Staging Environments**: Relying on brittle, shared end-to-end environments to test inter-service contracts instead of automated Consumer-Driven Contracts (CDC). This plugin establishes production-grade engineering standards for Spring Boot microservices across five foundational pillars: 1. **Architecture Boundaries & Domain Decomposition (`modern-microservices-architecture-and-decomposition`)**: Domain-Driven Design (DDD) Bounded Contexts, business capability mapping, strict database-per-service isolation, Anti-Corruption Layers (ACL), and API-First contract design (OpenAPI 3.1). 2. **Synchronous Inter-Service Communication (`modern-microservices-inter-service-communication`)**: Declarative HTTP Interfaces (`@HttpExchange`) configured on top of fluent `RestClient`, connection pool tuning, Resilience4j fault tolerance (Circuit Breakers, Timeouts, Rate Limiters, Bulkheads, Retries with jitter), and binary RPC via Spring gRPC. 3. **Event-Driven Architecture & Distributed Consistency (`modern-microservices-event-driven-and-data-consistency`)**: Spring for Apache Kafka (`KafkaTemplate`, `@KafkaListener`), Transactional Outbox pattern with Debezium CDC, Idempotent Consumers, Dead-Letter Topics (`.DLT`), Saga pattern (Orchestration vs Choreography), and schema registry evolution. 4. **Perimeter Gateway & Zero-Trust Security (`modern-microservices-perimeter-gateway-and-security`)**: Spring Cloud Gateway (MVC & Reactive), Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) patterns, centralized rate limiting (Redis), OAuth2/OIDC Token Relay filter, downstream Spring Security Stateless JWT Resource Servers, and service-to-service mTLS. 5. **Observability, Operations & Contract Testing (`modern-microservices-observability-and-resilience-ops`)**: Distributed Tracing with Micrometer Tracing & OpenTelemetry (W3C `traceparent` propagation), JSON structured logging with MDC (`traceId`, `spanId`), Kubernetes liveness/readiness probes, graceful shutdown, and Consumer-Driven Contract testing (Pact / Spring Cloud Contract) with WireMock. --- --- ## Core Technologies & Compatibility Baseline - **Language Baseline**: Java 21+ LTS (Virtual Threads, Pattern Matching, Records). - **Framework Baseline**: Spring Boot 3.2+, 3.3+, 3.4+, Spring Cloud 2023.0+ (Leyton). - **Communication**: Declarative HTTP Interfaces (`@HttpExchange`), `RestClient`, Spring gRPC. - **Resilience**: Resilience4j 2.2+, Spring Cloud CircuitBreaker. - **Event-Driven**: Spring for Apache Kafka 3.x, Debezium CDC, Kafka Connect. - **Perimeter & Security**: Spring Cloud Gateway (MVC & WebFlux), Spring Security 6.x OAuth2 Resource Server. - **Observability**: Micrometer 1.13+, Micrometer Tracing 1.3+, OpenTelemetry (OTel), Logstash Logback Encoder. - **Testing**: JUnit 5 Jupiter, AssertJ, Testcontainers 1.20+, Pact 4.6+ / Spring Cloud Contract, WireMock 3.x. --- --- ## What's Included (Component Catalog) ### Contextual Rules (`rules/`) Automatically loaded to govern and protect project contexts: - **[`modern-spring-boot-microservices.md`](rules/modern-spring-boot-microservices.md)**: >- ### Procedural Skills (`skills/`) On-demand actionable workflows and runbooks: - **[`/modern-microservices-architecture-and-decomposition`](skills/modern-microservices-architecture-and-decomposition/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill when defining microservice boundaries, applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) Bounded Contexts, implementing the database-per-service pattern, preventing distributed monoliths, creating Anti-Corruption Layers (ACL), or authoring API-First contracts with OpenAPI 3.1. - **[`/modern-microservices-event-driven-and-data-consistency`](skills/modern-microservices-event-driven-and-data-consistency/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill when designing asynchronous messaging, event-driven architectures with Apache Kafka, implementing the Transactional Outbox pattern with Debezium CDC, handling idempotent message consumption, managing Dead-Letter Topics (DLT), or orchestrating distributed transactions with the Saga pattern. - **[`/modern-microservices-inter-service-communication`](skills/modern-microservices-inter-service-communication/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill when implementing synchronous RPC communication between Spring Boot microservices: declarative HTTP interfaces (@HttpExchange), RestClient configuration, connection pool tuning, Resilience4j fault tolerance (CircuitBreaker, Retry, RateLimiter, Bulkhead, TimeLimiter), fallback mechanisms, or high-performance gRPC. - **[`/modern-microservices-observability-and-resilience-ops`](skills/modern-microservices-observability-and-resilience-ops/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill when implementing distributed tracing with Micrometer Tracing and OpenTelemetry (OTel), configuring structured JSON logging with MDC trace propagation, enabling Kubernetes liveness/readiness health probes, configuring graceful shutdown, or setting up Consumer-Driven Contract testing (Pact / Spring Cloud Contract) with WireMock. - **[`/modern-microservices-perimeter-gateway-and-security`](skills/modern-microservices-perimeter-gateway-and-security/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill when configuring API gateways with Spring Cloud Gateway (MVC or Reactive), designing Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) architectures, implementing OAuth2/OIDC Token Relay, securing downstream Spring Boot microservices as stateless JWT Resource Servers, or establishing service-to-service mTLS. --- ## Directory Hierarchy ```text modern-spring-boot-microservices-best-practices/ ├── plugin.json # Official Antigravity manifest (schema v1) ├── LICENSE # MIT License (Copyright 2026 HalcyonTech LTDA) ├── .gitignore # System ignores & installed_version.json exclusions ├── .gitattributes # Deterministic line endings (* text=auto eol=lf) ├── README.md # Golden Standard documentation & runbook ├── assets/ │ ├── logo.svg # Antigravity marketplace square icon │ └── halcyon-horizontal-cor.svg # Official Halcyon Tech brand logo (white background) # Official Halcyon Tech corporate vector symbol ├── rules/ # Contextual rules discovered automatically │ └── modern-spring-boot-microservices.md ├── skills/ # Actionable procedural skills (Progressive Disclosure) │ └── modern-microservices-architecture-and-decomposition/ │ └── SKILL.md │ └── modern-microservices-event-driven-and-data-consistency/ │ └── SKILL.md │ └── modern-microservices-inter-service-communication/ │ └── SKILL.md │ └── modern-microservices-observability-and-resilience-ops/ │ └── SKILL.md │ └── modern-microservices-perimeter-gateway-and-security/ │ └── SKILL.md ``` --- ## 💡 Prompt Recipes & Use Cases ```markdown -
